review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Job Role Design and develop cybersecurity solutions based on customer requirements and project specifications. Analyze tender documents, technical specifications, drawings, and contractual requirements. Identify technical risks, scope gaps, and compliance requirements during the bidding process. Minimum 5 years of experience in Cybersecurity Pre-Sales, Cybersecurity Engineering, or related technical roles. Hands-on knowledge of at least three of the following areas: Network and Perimeter Security (NGFW, WAF, IPS, DDoS) SIEM and Security Operations Center (SOC) Identity and Access Management (IAM/PAM) Endpoint Security and EDR Data Center and Cloud Security Proficiency in Microsoft Office and the ability to prepare clear, professional technical presentations.
